title: Maintenance Request Triage & Dispatch

blueprintSignals.name: Safety phrases
blueprintSignals.definition: presence of terms such as gas smell, flooding, no heating or sparks in the text
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Terms vary by language and dialect, so test on local phrasing

blueprintSignals.name: Image classifier
blueprintSignals.definition: probability that the photo shows a leak, mould, broken glass or electrical damage
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Photo quality varies, so require a confidence margin

blueprintSignals.name: Asset history
blueprintSignals.definition: number and type of repairs on the unit and the equipment in the last 24 months
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Records are incomplete for older buildings

blueprintSignals.name: Weather
blueprintSignals.definition: temperature and rain forecast at the building on the day
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Forecasts are uncertain, so use it as context and not as a rule

engineFeatures.meaning: words and phrases most associated with each class
which conversation or document family a text belongs to
when the text was written, for time-based splits
probability that the top class is right

label: For "Maintenance Request Triage & Dispatch": Classify tenant maintenance requests by urgency and trade and dispatch the right technician with the right parts. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Labels come from staff habits and may reflect past dispatch practice and not need.
